authorization.request: Process recent GitHub user feedback on DSH Store plugin scanning.
authorization.scope: Correct JavaScript/TypeScript Catalog permission-signal false positives reported in AI-Scarlett/DSH-Store#1243 and make source-update review use the same detector. Recheck findings locally at fixed public commits. No author contact, issue edits, Catalog/Candidate mutation, merge, deployment, DSH Profile changes, or third-party code execution.

implementation.scanner: For JavaScript/TypeScript runtime files, lexically mask comments, quoted strings, regex literals, and template raw text while retaining executable template interpolation. Run import and permission-call heuristics only where source positions are code. Preserve conservative raw scanning for other languages and retain protected-DSH checks.
implementation.integration: Pass each fixed-source runtime path into the permission scanner and reuse its result for source-update risk review instead of maintaining a duplicate raw command-call regex.
implementation.safety: This reduces text-only false positives; it does not approve or install plugins. Actual filesystem, network, command, credential, compatibility, lifecycle, and bounded-source gates remain unchanged.

feedbackDisposition.issue1243: Reproduce the reported CLI help-text false positives against the author's stated fixed Commit. Fix the scanner only. The repository's real filesystem/network capabilities remain signals, so no automatic approval is requested or granted.
feedbackDisposition.issue1260: The latest precheck was already run against the newer fixed Commit da33e4ae00e2576856e57c125dd993f48617d848. It is incomplete due source/tree/file bounds and reports child-process calls; retain the candidate as non-installable. No reply or re-trigger is made here.

deterministicGates: Precondition hashes and absent plan path match the pinned base before mutation.
Focused permission-scan and source-update tests cover help text, comments, regex literals, template prose, code interpolation, real imports, real calls, and UTF-16 offsets.
Review changed paths and ensure no Catalog/Candidate, DSH core, Profile, or contact-ledger files are modified.
Open an auditable draft source PR; do not merge or deploy in this run.

rollback.reference: Close the draft PR or revert its exact source commit through an auditable PR. No Catalog/Profile state is changed; never reset or mutate the global author-contact ledger.

externalEffects: A draft source PR and its CI checks only. No GitHub issue/comment notification to the authors, Catalog scan dispatch, Catalog/Candidate write, production release, or third-party code execution.
